title: UCL Disagreeing Well
discussion_signal: UCL’s event discussion treats disagreement as potentially constructive and publicly valuable when grounded in open debate, rigorous exchange, and space for difficult questions.
linked_research_question: Why do Britons value open disagreement while experiencing a shrinking and socially costly public space for expressing it?
limits: The post describes an event rather than measuring speech restraint
Audience and panel discussion are not representative public opinion
Constructive debate framing may understate unequal risks of speaking publicly
